moves.note: ailments as stated: Shred Lightning Resistance

moves.name: Orbiting Comet
moves.avoid: For Orbiting Comet you need to stand in melee range of Shade to avoid the projectiles. ... if you do have to move out to avoid something make sure to get back in melee range quickly
moves.maxrollQuote: A large number of projectiles circle Shade from multiple distances away, dealing high Cold Damage that increases over its duration. Comets do not circle within Melee Range of Shade.

moves.name: Frozen Ice Storm
moves.avoid: Frozen Ice Storm is easy to avoid since it moves in a straight line. As soon as Shade uses it move away from the area.
moves.maxrollQuote: Shade fires a slow moving, high Cold Damage projectile that grows in size and increases in damage over its lifetime.

moves.name: Blood Effigy
moves.severity: its damage will eventually increase to certain death if it isn't dealt with.
moves.avoid: Blood Effigy has unavoidable damage that ramps up quickly so it needs to be killed immediately.
moves.maxrollQuote: Shade creates a copy of himself in the center of the ring. The copy does not move but deals Physical Damage to the player that increases over the duration of the skill. Effigy will not despawn and must be killed, meaning its damage will eventually increase to certain death if it isn't dealt with.

moves.name: Blood Orb
moves.avoid: They can be dealt with either by avoiding them for long enough that they explode away from you or by taking out one at a time so that the damage is manageable.
moves.maxrollQuote: Shade spawns three orbs that seek out the player and explode on impact, dealing high Physical Damage. They will eventually despawn if they do not reach the player in time.

moves.name: Poison Puke
moves.tell: Shade rears back and then fires a conal projectile
moves.avoid: The best strategy for dealing with a Poison Shade is to continuously strafe around him throughout the fight. Doing so will prevent either skill from being dropped directly on top of you.
moves.maxrollQuote: Shade rears back and then fires a conal projectile in front of him that does high Poison Damage, increases in damage over its duration and applies Poison.

moves.name: Toxic Spread
moves.avoid: The best strategy for dealing with a Poison Shade is to continuously strafe around him throughout the fight. Doing so will prevent either skill from being dropped directly on top of you.
moves.maxrollQuote: Shade creates several Poison pools in front of him in a line formation that do high Poison Damage. The damage increases over the duration of the skill.

moves.name: Concentrated Burst
moves.tell: Shade creates several conal AoEs originating from his body. After a short period these explode
moves.avoid: Concentrated Burst is a dangerous skill but easy to avoid. ... Concentrated Burst significantly decreases the size of the arena, so you need to keep track of his other abilities and make sure there's an area of the arena you can move to that will avoid Burst as well as his other abilities.
moves.maxrollQuote: Shade creates several conal AoEs originating from his body. After a short period these explode dealing very high Void Damage.

moves.name: Circle of Death
moves.tell: The circle farthest from Shade is created first while the one closest is created last.
moves.maxrollQuote: Shade creates several large AoE circles that explode for moderate Void Damage in quick succession. The circle farthest from Shade is created first while the one closest is created last.

moves.name: Bursting Void
moves.maxrollQuote: Shade creates a large circle at the player's feet that quickly explodes, dealing moderate Void Damage.

moves.name: Crystal Crush
moves.tell: Shade creates a large crystal over his head and quickly slams it down in front of him
moves.maxrollQuote: Shade creates a large crystal over his head and quickly slams it down in front of him, dealing moderate Void Damage.

moves.name: Black Hole Decay
moves.avoid: Black Hole Decay is a quick killer for anyone who stands in it. Fortunately it's easy to avoid.
moves.maxrollQuote: Shade creates three lines of Black Holes that project outward from his body. Each Black Hole does high Void Damage that increases over its duration.

moves.name: Absorbing Meteors
moves.avoid: The risk of being hit is higher the closer you are to Shade. When he uses this skill stop attacking him and give yourself some space to dance around the meteors.
moves.maxrollQuote: Shade becomes a black hole that pulls in meteors from off screen and absorbs them. Each meteor can hit the player, dealing moderate Void Damage.

moves.name: Mini Black Holes
moves.avoid: The best way to deal with them is to set off a few at a time by running right through them without stopping. This will cause them to explode behind you. Rinse and repeat until all of the Black Holes are detonated.
moves.maxrollQuote: A large number of small Black Holes appear from off screen and slowly seek out the player. If a Black Hole touches the player it will explode after a short duration, dealing moderate Void Damage.

moves.name: Melee Attack
moves.maxrollQuote: Shade swipes at the player in Melee Range, dealing low Physical and Void Damage. He will always have access to this skill regardless of what other skills he has.

moves.name: Falling Meteor
moves.avoid: Falling Meteor is deadly to anyone who stands in it. Move out of the way until it expires.
moves.maxrollQuote: Shade creates a very large meteor in front of him that slowly falls to the ground, dealing high Void Damage that increases over its duration.

moves.name: Exploding Black Hole
moves.avoid: Exploding Black Hole has two components, but only one Black Hole is dangerous so don't stand in it. The projectiles do very little damage.
moves.maxrollQuote: Three black holes are created at random places in the arena that deal high Void Damage and increase in size and damage over their duration. When they expire they explode and fire projectiles in a star pattern that deal low Void Damage.

moves.name: Void Rift
moves.avoid: When he fires the projectile look for the rift in the arena and strafe around it and at a distance to avoid being hit by the projectile when it comes through the rift.
moves.maxrollQuote: Shade forms a ball of Void and then fires it at the player. The projectile deals high Void Damage. Upon reaching the end of the arena, the projectile is teleported through a rift back into the arena and targets the player a second time.

moves.name: Void Meteor
moves.severity: This will one shot most builds!
moves.tell: Shade shouts 'The end comes!' signaling the start of this attack. Shortly after, a very large meteor flies across the arena in a telegraphed direction
moves.avoid: In order to reliably avoid the meteor, listen to what Shade says. If he shouts "The end comes!" be prepared to run or use a movement ability to get out of the telegraph. The direction of the meteor is random, so you need to really pay attention in order to determine which way to move and get out in time.
moves.maxrollQuote: Shade shouts 'The end comes!' signaling the start of this attack. Shortly after, a very large meteor flies across the arena in a telegraphed direction, dealing extremely high Physical and Void damage. This will one shot most builds!

moves.name: Summon Tentacles
moves.avoid: Summon Tentacles and Summon Eyes aren't difficult on their own, but they can stack with other abilities and overwhelm. Kill them quickly to avoid having too much to worry about.
moves.maxrollQuote: Shade summons three Tentacles which have a line shaped Melee Attack that does moderate Physical and Void damage and also has high Stun Chance. The Tentacles can be killed.

moves.name: Summon Eyes
moves.avoid: Summon Tentacles and Summon Eyes aren't difficult on their own, but they can stack with other abilities and overwhelm. Kill them quickly to avoid having too much to worry about.
moves.maxrollQuote: Shade will summon five Eyes that will continuously fire a beam of moderate Void Damage at the player at the same time. The Eyes can be killed.

moves.name: Piercing Void
moves.maxrollQuote: Shade quickly fires a projectile at the player that does low Void Damage.

moves.name: Dark Warp
moves.maxrollQuote: Shade warps from his current position to nearby the player.

moves.name: Oblivion Leap
moves.avoid: Oblivion Leap, Void Reform, and Void Rush all have telegraphs that can be easily avoided.
moves.maxrollQuote: Shade leaps towards the player's current position. Upon landing he slams the ground, dealing moderate Physical and Void damage.

moves.name: Oblivion Dash
moves.maxrollQuote: Shade runs at a high speed towards the player, dealing low Void Damage if he collides with the player.

moves.name: Void Reform
moves.avoid: Oblivion Leap, Void Reform, and Void Rush all have telegraphs that can be easily avoided.
moves.maxrollQuote: Shade explodes his body at his current position and reforms it on the player's position, creating a second explosion. Each explosion deals moderate Void Damage.

moves.name: Void Rush
moves.avoid: Oblivion Leap, Void Reform, and Void Rush all have telegraphs that can be easily avoided.
moves.maxrollQuote: Shade slowly moves towards the player's position with a large Void Barrier in front of him. The barrier Deals moderate Void Damage.

tips: If Shade shouts The end comes, a Void Meteor crosses the arena and one shots most builds. Read its direction and leave the line at once.
Kill Blood Effigy right away, because its Physical damage ramps until it dies. Starburst circles and Black Hole Decay also kill fast.
Every Shade uses Void skills, so keep Void resistance capped. Its second element changes from fight to fight.
strategy: Single phase (None): He's a single phase fight and has all of his abilities available and at full strength from the start.

skill selection quote: For each fight Shade will drop skills following this structure: Both skills from one of five Damage Types (Fire, Lightning, Cold, Physical, Poison); Three Void Skills; One Movement Skill; Basic Melee Attack
location: Shade of Orobyss is a unique fight in the Monolith of Fate. Instead of requiring stability to fight him, he can show up on any timeline as an Echo.
Maxroll guide line: Due to the nature of how Shade chooses his skills it's impossible to come up with a general strategy for every encounter.
Maxroll guide line: The key to defeating Shade is knowing which of his abilities are the most dangerous and learning to avoid them.
Maxroll guide line: Shade's most dangerous skill is Void Meteor which has a short telegraph and will one shot most builds.
Maxroll guide line: All of Shade's movement abilities are not very threatening and only used when the player is out of melee range.

Maxroll guide line: Modifiers to avoid (per page): Critical Strike Avoidance (crit builds); Enemies have +X Critical Strike Chance (if not crit-avoidance capped); Enemies have a chance to Dodge (hit-based builds); Enemies heal if they have not been damaged recently; Frenzy and Haste + Enrage together; Increased X Damage - 'Shade always has Void Damage so you can be sure it will scale some of his abilities.'
shade-of-orobyss.summary: Included because the task listed it as a candidate 'if listed as pinnacle'. Maxroll files it under Monolith and calls it 'a unique fight in the Monolith of Fate', not a pinnacle and not a timeline boss. Drop it if the timeline-boss worker already covers it.
shade-of-orobyss.resist: You always need Void Resistance and you never need Necrotic Resistance. Everything else is luck of the draw.
shade-of-orobyss.kind: monolith_echo_boss (Maxroll does NOT label it pinnacle)

morditasStub.location: Demigod's Ascendance is the Woven Echo that unlocks the fight with Pinnacle Morditas. You can obtain this by defeating the standard Morditas boss encounter in Circle of Frozen Blood. Demigod's Ascendance requires 400 Corruption to place into your Echo Web.
general_tips: The Pinnacle version of Morditas is more difficult than the standard Morditas fight and does not scale with Corruption. It is positioned between Aberroth and Uber Aberroth in difficulty.
morditasStub.notes: New Season 5 pinnacle boss (released Oct 1, 2026). As of Oct 2, 2026 Maxroll has no boss/mechanics guide for it, only the Rage of Morditas mechanic page (access and rewards). No abilities listed.
